name: Prague Castle & Hradčany
text: Cathedral animals, a working postbox and gardens where the day slows down.

name: Charles Bridge & Lesser Town
text: Statue hunts, a wishing spot and playgrounds right under the bridge.

name: Old Town
text: The astronomical clock, towers to climb and hidden details for sharp eyes.
